goal: Define the canonical Airframe domain model and load sample workspace/project configuration through AirframeCore, AICockpit, and AgileCockpit.
notes: Acceptance Criteria: 1. AirframeCore loads valid sample configuration. 2. AirframeCore rejects malformed configuration with structured errors. 3. AICockpit displays current workspace/project context. 4. AgileCockpit displays current workspace/project context. 5. Core, CLI, and app tests cover the sample configuration path.
rationale: All clients need a common vocabulary and configuration source before workflow, backend, metrics, or UI behavior can be implemented safely.
scope: Define canonical IDs and entity models.
